title: Spam-path handler wiring unpinned: honeypot/timing call sites passing genuine_submission=False have no handler-level test
detail: Frozen spec constraint: spam fake-confirmation must NOT fire the confirmation event. View render and JS outcomeEvent mapping are pinned, but flipping the False literal at either call site fires application_confirmation_viewed on bot renders and no test fails.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test posting a honeypot-filled (or timing-suspicious) form through handle_post_form asserting data-apply-page="spam-confirmation" and absence of /static/apply_analytics.js.

title: Reminder-button enable/disable predicate and list-derived stage counts untested (only label strings pinned)
detail: Behaviour changed from `remindable == 0 || pending`; a revert greys out the button whenever only follow-ups are due, making stage 2 unsendable, and no test fails. The followup_due-filter count derivation is likewise unpinned.
recommended_fix: Extract pure helpers (reminder_button_disabled, stage counts from items) and pin them, or add a view-level test asserting the button is enabled with remindable=0, followup>0.

title: Dublin-local closes_at conversion in find_vacancy_for_invite untested — feeds the stage-2 deadline email's announced date
evidence:
to_char(v.closes_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS closes_at
(grep of server/test: zero references to find_vacancy_for_invite; the SQL comment itself warns "A bare ::text cast would render the DB session's UTC clock, which can read as the day before an Irish close.")
detail: This new column feeds reminder_stage2_subject/build_reminder_stage2_html ("applications close 13 August 2026"). format_close_date is unit-tested and the closes_at>now() view gate is integration-tested, but the timezone conversion itself has no assertion.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test seeding a late-evening-UTC closes_at, calling sql.find_vacancy_for_invite, and asserting the Dublin-local YYYY-MM-DD string.
